scenicChapters.title: Alpujarras Mountain Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 17 km this is Alpujarras Mountain Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Alpujarras Mountain Road
scenicChapters.narrative: First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding. The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 6.6%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter.

scenicChapters.title: Alpujarras Mountain Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2041 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

alpujarras-mountain-road.story: From Granada it runs 156 km to Guadix; allow about 2 h 15 of riding. It goes by way of Lanjaron, Pampaneira, Trevelez and Puerto de la Ragua. The highest point is about 2,050 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
